title: The Emerald SMP Texture Pack
description: This is a texture pack for our server.
body: This mtexture pack os for The Emerald SMP. It turns emerald blocks and ore and just emeralds in dollar bills and stuff so we can better use them as curency. It is to show that emeralds are the currency and make it less confusing.
